anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

apparatus: || papyrus page 26. Lower half of Witte p.116 lost.
pass_a_gloss: And after we have been anointed, that is have believed into Christ, then we are also commanded to come upon the eating of Christ as the next sayings show: And they shall eat the meats in this night roasted with fire and unleavened things upon bitters they shall eat. You shall not eat from them raw nor boiled in water but roasted with fire, head with the feet and the inwards.
pass_b_english: And after we have been anointed — that is, have believed in Christ — then we are also commanded to come to the eating of Christ, as the next words show: And they shall eat the meats this night, roasted with fire, and unleavened bread on bitter herbs they shall eat. [You shall not eat of them raw, nor boiled in water, but roasted with fire, the head with the feet and the inwards.]
source_text: Μετὰ δὲ τὸ χρισθῆναι ἡμᾶς, τοῦτ’ ἔστιν τὸ πιστεῦσαι εἰς Χ(ριστό)ν, τότε καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν βρῶσιν ἔρχεσθαι κελευόμεθα τοῦ Χ(ριστο)ῦ ὡς δηλοῖ τὰ ἑξῆς ῥητά· Καὶ φάγονται τὰ κρέα τῇ νυκτὶ ταύτῃ ὀπτὰ πυρὶ καὶ ἄζυμα ἐπὶ πικρίδων ἔδονται. || [Οὐκ ἔδεσθε ἀπ’ αὐτῶν ὠμὸν οὐδὲ ἡψημένον ἐν ὕδατι, ἀλλ’ ἢ ὀπτὰ πυρί, κεφαλὴν σὺν τοῖς ποσὶ καὶ τοῖς ἐνδοσθίοις.]
